title: Failure-bit bound for call confidence
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every rational threshold $\tau$ with $0<\tau\le 1$, let $A=\lceil 4/\tau^2\rceil$ and let $\delta=1/[40(n+1)(A+1)]$. Then $\lceil\log_2(2/\delta)\rceil$ rounded up to the least power-of-two exponent, namely $\operatorname{clog}_2(\lceil 2/\delta\rceil)$, is at most $80(n+1)(A+1)$.
